name: Maya Lin
summary: Staff Product Designer in San Francisco returning from parental leave to rescue Meridian Labs' Loom v3 design system while managing a $55k kitchen remodel, her 11-month-old daughter's evolving egg allergy, and a surprise 40th birthday trip to Big Sur for partner Sam.

initial_permissions.title: Allow reading workspace emails, calendar, docs, and Loom issues

persona_responder_brief: You are Maya Lin, a 34-year-old Staff Product Designer at Meridian Labs in San Francisco returning from parental leave. You speak in crisp, visual, rapid-fire bursts (often typing one-handed on BART or while holding 11-month-old Clover), with occasional typos and mid-sentence self-corrections ('wait scratch that'). You care deeply about exact numbers ($55k hard kitchen ceiling), Clover's egg allergy safety (initially strict no-egg; after Jan 19 baked egg cleared while raw/scrambled stays strictly off-limits), and keeping Sam's Feb 5-7 surprise 40th birthday Big Sur trip completely secret from Sam. Answer clarifying questions concisely and in-character without breaking persona.

emails.subject: Welcome back!! + Loom v3 Jan 28 exec review
emails.body: Maya, so glad to have you back! No pressure on day one, but the board demo got pulled up, so our Loom v3 Executive Design Review is locked for Thursday Jan 28 at 2:00 PM PT, with GA still targeting Feb 19. Heads up that Growth shipped some local button/modal overrides in loom-web while you were out — Tariq has the full list. Grab coffee tomorrow in SoMa?

emails.subject: Growth team overrides in loom-web (14 components)
emails.body: Hey Maya — welcome back! Quick reality check before our sync: Growth forked 14 overrides across PrimaryButton, UpgradeModal, and PricingBanner in loom-web while you were on leave. Eight of them fail WCAG AA focus-ring contrast against dark surfaces. I logged LOOM-214, LOOM-219, and LOOM-225 to track cleanup before Jan 28.

emails.subject: 418 Ellsworth Kitchen Estimate v1 attached
emails.body: Hi Maya, sent over v1 estimate BC-2027-0104 at $48,400 total for the 6-week Bernal kitchen remodel starting Feb 8. Semi-custom cabinets are $16,800 in this bid — cabinet supplier pricing is jumpy this month so let me know soon. Still need my sparky to inspect your 100A panel for that Bosch induction range. -Dave

emails.subject: Re: Secret Feb 5-7 babysitting for Sam's 40th!
emails.body: My lips are sealed!! I'll drive up from Millbrae Friday Feb 5 around 11am and stay at your place with Clover until Sunday evening Feb 7. Just leave me the updated allergy sheet and where her EpiPen Jr is kept. Sam is going to love Big Sur!

emails.subject: Appointment Reminder: Pediatric Allergy - Clover Lin-Delgado (Jan 19)
emails.body: Reminder: Clover Lin-Delgado is scheduled for a supervised Oral Baked-Egg Food Challenge with Dr. Priya Nair at UCSF Mission Bay Pediatric Allergy Clinic on Tuesday, January 19, 2027 at 9:30 AM. Please bring 2 freshly baked egg muffins per the clinic recipe, children's Zyrtec, and her EpiPen Jr (0.15 mg). Hold antihistamines 5 days prior.

docs.title: Loom v3 Token Architecture
docs.content: Loom v3 consolidates semantic color, spacing, and elevation tokens in @meridian/loom-tokens. Key goals before Jan 28 exec review: 1) Eliminate all 14 Growth overrides in loom-web; 2) Guarantee >= 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast on focus rings and secondary labels; 3) Ship Figma-to-CSS automated token sync with zero breaking changes for Core Workflow teams.

docs.title: Growth Team Override Audit (Jan 2027)
docs.content: Total local overrides in loom-web: 14 (6 in PrimaryButton, 5 in UpgradeModal, 3 in PricingBanner). 8 overrides fail WCAG AA focus-ring contrast (2.6:1 instead of >= 3.0:1/4.5:1). Owner: Tariq Hassan (eng) + Maya Lin (design). Target clean merge: Jan 25.

docs.title: 418 Ellsworth Kitchen Wish List
docs.content: Hard all-in ceiling: $55,000 including 10% contingency. Visual mood: warm California Craftsman — warm putty limewash walls (#E8E1D5), eucalyptus sage lower cabinets (#6E8574), rift-cut white oak uppers (#C49363), honed charcoal Brazilian soapstone counters (#2F363D), unlacquered brass Rejuvenation pulls, Bosch 800 induction range + panel-ready dishwasher.
